description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Advances the pack by running up to about 15 seconds of rendering work, then reports current status -- including the Style Sheet's own status and image URL (`designPackage`) and whether it has been approved (`designApproved`), plus per-scene status. A sheet-pack scene (panel-pack/label-pack/sub-badge-pack/ emote-pack) passes through an extra "tiles" stage after its sheet image renders (cropping + uploading each tile) and, once done, reports a `tiles` array (index, label, enabled, a signed download `url`, and an export-ladder `sizes` array for sub-badge-pack/emote-pack). This call has side effects -- call it repeatedly (e.g. every few seconds) until `complete` is true; each call both progresses the pack and returns its latest state. Works on a design-sheet-only project too (from create_design_sheet, before any scene exists) -- poll it until designPackage.status is "ready", then call approve_design_sheet. Every image/video link this returns (designPackage.imageUrl, previewImageUrl, resultUrl, tile urls) is a direct, absolute, signed download URL that opens with no AlertForge login -- never a dashboard link. Links expire after a while, so re-poll to get fresh ones rather than caching one long-term.

projectId.description: projectId returned by create_design_sheet or create_overlay_pack.
